etsy.title: Half Double Crochet Dishcloth Pattern PDF, Easy Cotton Washcloth with Border, Beginner Crochet, English German Hungarian
etsy.description:
A sturdy, square cotton dishcloth in simple rows of half double crochet with a neat border. About 1.5 hours, great for practising even rows.

• Skill level: beginner (2/6)
• Size: about 20 × 20 cm (8 × 8 in)
• Hook: 4.5 mm
• Yarn: about 45 g worsted 100% cotton

PDF PATTERN ONLY – not the finished item. Instant download in 3 languages: English (US terms + UK table), German (Deutsch) and Hungarian (magyar).
Includes a stitch chart (symbol diagram), a finished-shape sketch with measurements and a symbol key.
New pattern: the first image is the stitch chart; a maker-tested photo will be added.
For personal use and small-batch handmade sales with credit to AureliaVenn. Please don't share or resell the pattern.

Written with the help of AI tools; stitch counts checked round by round.
